sentences.en: Well, we're going to get more of Michael's reaction to all of this in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在下一集中，我们将看到迈克对这一切的更多反应。

sentences.en: We end this episode, though, with Angela and Dwight's dinner date.
sentences.zh: 不过，这一集的结尾是安吉拉和德怀特的晚餐约会。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, lady, I have some location trivia.
sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，我有一些关于拍摄地的小知识。

sentences.en: I know you love a good location story.
sentences.zh: 我知道你喜欢听拍摄地的故事。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我确实喜欢。

sentences.en: And I will tell you, Ivy Burke will be very excited to hear what you have to say because Ivy would like to know where you filmed the Dwight and Angela dinner.
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你，艾薇·伯克听到你要说的内容一定会很兴奋，因为艾薇想知道你们是在哪里拍摄德怀特和安吉拉的晚餐戏份的。

sentences.en: We filmed it in the most beautiful neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个非常美丽的社区拍摄的。

sentences.en: It's called the Malibu Lake Mountain Club.
sentences.zh: 它叫马里布湖山俱乐部。

sentences.en: It's a private community, so much so that there are no signs off the freeway for it.
sentences.zh: 那是一个私人社区，甚至连高速公路上都没有通往那里的指示牌。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's like they don't want to be found.
sentences.zh: 是啊，就好像他们不想被人找到一样。

sentences.en: It's really, really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那里真的非常非常漂亮。

sentences.en: This neighborhood was created in 1924.
sentences.zh: 这个社区建于1924年。

sentences.en: It was just like a valley.
sentences.zh: 当时那里就像个山谷。

sentences.en: And they made a lake, a man-made lake.
sentences.zh: 他们造了一个湖，一个人工湖。

sentences.en: And the members really wanted to keep it a secret.
sentences.zh: 成员们真的很想保守这个秘密。

sentences.en: So they removed the highway signs that gave directions to the lake, hoping to hide it from tourists.
sentences.zh: 所以他们拆除了高速公路上指向该湖的指示牌，希望能避开游客。

sentences.en: In 1936, they built a clubhouse with a ballroom and a large patio.
sentences.zh: 1936年，他们建造了一个带舞厅和大露台的会所。

sentences.en: And it had a speakeasy poker room and a mural of the original members.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一个地下酒吧风格的扑克室和一幅原始成员的壁画。

sentences.en: And only members can use the lake and the swimming pool and the tennis court.
sentences.zh: 只有会员才能使用湖泊、游泳池和网球场。

sentences.en: So it's this little private community.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个小小的私人社区。

sentences.en: Ronald Reagan was the honorary mayor.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根曾是那里的名誉市长。

sentences.en: And technically, that's the first political office he ever held.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，那是他担任的第一个政治职务。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Now, let me ask you a question.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我问你一个问题。

sentences.en: Did you film at this location because this lake is going to feature prominently in the next episode?
sentences.zh: 你们在这里取景，是因为这个湖会在下一集里有重要戏份吗？

sentences.en: Ding, ding, ding, ding, ding.
sentences.zh: 答对了，答对了，答对了。

sentences.en: Okay, so we had this location for one day.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们在这个场地只有一天的拍摄时间。

sentences.en: Dwight and Angela filmed their dinner date in the lodge at Malibu Lake, their restaurant.
sentences.zh: 德怀特和安吉拉在马里布湖的旅馆里拍摄了他们的晚餐约会，也就是他们的餐厅。

sentences.en: And then we will see what happens to Michael and Dwight with the lake in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会在下一集里看到迈克尔和德怀特在湖边发生了什么。

sentences.en: But that was all the same day.
sentences.zh: 但那都是在同一天拍的。

sentences.en: We filmed our scene at night.
sentences.zh: 我们是在晚上拍的那场戏。

sentences.en: So, Jenna, I had a late call time.
sentences.zh: 所以，珍娜，我的通告时间很晚。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: There was this huge moon.
sentences.zh: 当时月亮特别大。

sentences.en: And after we did the scene, I walked out on this floating dock and just watched the moon for a minute.
sentences.zh: 拍完那场戏后，我走到浮动码头上，盯着月亮看了一会儿。

sentences.en: And it was just like, you know, one of those magical nights on set where you're like,
sentences.zh: 那种感觉，你知道，就像片场里那些神奇的夜晚，你会觉得，

sentences.en: this feels so cool because it's really a beautiful little area.
sentences.zh: 这感觉太棒了，因为这确实是一个非常美丽的小地方。

sentences.en: And Steve Carell has made their official website.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·卡瑞尔还上了他们的官网。

sentences.en: Ready for this?
sentences.zh: 准备好听这个了吗？

sentences.en: It says, just a few of the famous faces that have shot here.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，这里拍摄过的一些名人面孔。

sentences.en: Charlie Chaplin, W.C.
sentences.zh: 查理·卓别林，W.C.

sentences.en: Fields, Diane Lane, Lloyd Bridges, Lucille Ball, Steve Carell,
sentences.zh: 菲尔兹，黛安·莲恩，劳埃德·布里奇斯，露西尔·鲍尔，史蒂夫·卡瑞尔，

sentences.en: Betty Davis, Henry Fonda.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·戴维斯，亨利·方达。

sentences.en: It goes on and on.
sentences.zh: 名单长着呢。

sentences.en: But Steve Carell made the liSt.
sentences.zh: 但史蒂夫·卡瑞尔居然上了名单。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: I know, right?
sentences.zh: 是吧？

sentences.en: Really fun.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: But this scene between Rain and I, I just loved doing it.
sentences.zh: 但我跟雷恩的那场戏，我特别喜欢演。

sentences.en: We took the scene apart because Dwight is hoping that it's one thing.
sentences.zh: 我们拆解了那场戏，因为德怀特希望那是另一回事。

sentences.en: Angela's trying for it to be a reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉则试图让它成为一次和解。

sentences.en: And then she just can't do it.
sentences.zh: 但最后她还是做不到。

sentences.en: And they wanted me to be able to show that emotion in my face that I was trying.
sentences.zh: 他们希望我能通过面部表情表现出那种我在努力尝试的情绪。

sentences.en: And then I just couldn't get past it.
sentences.zh: 然后我就是过不去心里那道坎。

sentences.en: I couldn't get past it.
sentences.zh: 我过不去。

sentences.en: And it's got a couplet of dialogue that I love.
sentences.zh: 里面有两句我很喜欢的对白。

sentences.en: It's when Angela says, I heard a joke today.
sentences.zh: 就是安吉拉说，我今天听了个笑话。

sentences.en: And Dwight says, oh, that's funny.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，哦，那挺好笑的。

sentences.en: And Angela says, yes, it was.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，是的，确实好笑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, this scene is just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这场戏真的很美。

sentences.en: It's beautiful for all the reasons you said.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，它美在方方面面。

sentences.en: It's funny, but then it breaks your heart because your performance, Angela, we really see your
sentences.zh: 它很有趣，但又让人心碎，因为你的表演，安吉拉，我们真的看到了你的

sentences.en: character's heart breaking in this moment.
sentences.zh: 角色在这一刻心碎了。

sentences.en: And it's just real.
sentences.zh: 而且非常真实。

sentences.en: Like you aren't playing it for comedy.
sentences.zh: 你不是为了搞笑而演。

sentences.en: It's just real.
sentences.zh: 它就是真实的。

sentences.en: And these are the moments of The Office that I'm so proud of as a television comedy that
sentences.zh: 这些时刻让我为《办公室》这部电视喜剧感到无比自豪，

sentences.en: we took these moments to get really real.
sentences.zh: 我们抓住了这些时刻，让它变得非常真实。

sentences.en: Thanks, ladies.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，女士们。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I really enjoyed the storyline.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢这个故事线。

sentences.en: I love Dwight and Angela being together.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢德怀特和安吉拉在一起。

sentences.en: And I loved when they were at odds.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢他们针锋相对的时候。

sentences.en: It was equally fun to play.
sentences.zh: 演起来也同样有趣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's such a good dynamic.
sentences.zh: 这种互动太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jenna, one of the things that got me so tickled was that during this time,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道吗，珍娜，有一件事让我特别开心，那就是在那段时间里，

sentences.en: the Dwight-Angela relationship was compared by a TV journalist to Hot Lips Houlihan and Frank
sentences.zh: 有位电视记者把德怀特和安吉拉的关系比作《陆军野战医院》里的

sentences.en: from MASH.
sentences.zh: “热唇”豪利汉和弗兰克。

sentences.en: And that was a show I grew up watching with my dad.
sentences.zh: 那是我小时候和我爸一起看的剧。

sentences.en: And I just was so tickled by that.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的觉得特别有意思。

sentences.en: Oh, that's perfect.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太贴切了。

sentences.en: And that was Dunder Mifflin Infinity Part One.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《邓德·米夫林无限公司》第一部分的内容。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I would like to say thank you to Joya Balfour for giving us the digital media inside info.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢乔亚·巴尔弗为我们提供了数字媒体方面的内幕信息。

sentences.en: And you can check out her website at joyabalfour.com for some fun stuff that they were doing at
sentences.zh: 你们可以访问她的网站 joyabalfour.com，看看他们当时做的一些有趣的事情，

sentences.en: nbc.com.
sentences.zh: nbc.com.

sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们继续讲这个故事线时，会有一些精美的礼品篮和一个大型特技表演，

sentences.en: especially for our show.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的节目来说尤其特别。

sentences.en: I was so impressed.
sentences.zh: 我印象太深刻了。

sentences.en: I can't wait to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想聊聊它了。

sentences.en: All right, you guys, have a great week.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，祝你们度过愉快的一周。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下次见。

sentences.zh: 再见。
